title: The tangent cocycle in a concrete overlap
promptMarkdown: On the positive quadrant use coordinates $(x,y)$ and $(u,v)=(\log x,y/x)$. Compute the component transformation of a tangent vector $a\partial_x+b\partial_y$, its inverse, and $df$ for $f(x,y)=y/x$. Verify that the derivation of $f$ agrees in both coordinate systems.
hintLadder: Invert the coordinate map before differentiating its inverse.
In the new chart $f$ is one of the coordinate functions.
